LanguageData.LP_SatyrRevelry.stages.0.label: revelry
LanguageData.LP_SatyrRevelry.stages.0.description: Music, wine and dancing: that's what living is!
LanguageData.LP_DryadTreeDied.stages.0.label: my tree died
LanguageData.LP_DryadTreeDied.stages.0.description: Half of me died along with it.
LanguageData.LP_DryadDistantThought.stages.0.label: far from the tree
LanguageData.LP_DryadDistantThought.stages.0.descript: My roots are being pulled painfully. I need to go back.
LanguageData.LP_DryadDriftingThought.stages.0.label: drifting
LanguageData.LP_DryadDriftingThought.stages.0.descrip: Without a tree of my own, I'm like a leaf blown along by the wind.
LanguageData.LP_ChangelingSelfThought.stages.0.label: forgot my own face
LanguageData.LP_ChangelingSelfThought.stages.0.descri: Who's the person in the mirror? I haven't been myself for a month.
LanguageData.LP_PixieDustJoy.stages.0.label: fey dust
LanguageData.LP_PixieDustJoy.stages.0.description: The sprite sprinkled a handful of sparkling dust; I can't help laughing.
